[SIBAWAYH:(هذابابماجاءمعدولاعنحدهمنالمؤنث)#547/r15] SIBAWAYH, d. 180 · author | holds | مساس means do not touch me or I will not touch you, while كفاف means leave me alone; both are shifted feminine forms even though their base feminine forms are unattested.
[SIBAWAYH:(هذابابماجاءمعدولاعنحدهمنالمؤنث)#547/r16] SIBAWAYH, d. 180 · author | holds | Some plurals follow feminine forms never used on their own, such as ملامح, مشابه, and ليال from unattested singulars like ملمحة and ليلاة.

[SIBAWAYH:(هذابابماجاءمعدولاعنحدهمنالمؤنث)#547/r2] SIBAWAYH, d. 180 · author | holds | فعال commands retain the same form for a woman, man, or group, take an accusative complement, and cannot take person or number endings because the form is a noun with verbal meaning.

[SIBAWAYH:(هذابابماجاءمعدولاعنحدهمنالمؤنث)#547/r21] SIBAWAYH, d. 180 · author | holds | When a فعال form is used as a masculine name, it is not treated as feminine; indefinite forms take tanwīn, and some Arabs also tanwīn masculine رقاش and غلاب.
[SIBAWAYH:(هذابابماجاءمعدولاعنحدهمنالمؤنث)#547/r22] SIBAWAYH, d. 180 · author | holds | If a فعال noun's origin or gender is unknown, the default is to decline it with tanwīn because most words of this pattern are ordinary nouns such as الذهاب and الصلاح.
